classification.difficultyReason: Translate endpoint coordinates into plotted intervals, identify their perpendicular changes and connect these to the taught distance calculation, including intervals crossing an axis.

content.prompt: Plot these intervals on the Cartesian plane and calculate the distance to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Blank Cartesian plane with unit grid, every nonzero integer tick labelled, unlabelled origin and arrows at both ends of both axes. A blank-grid template cannot express the numbered coordinate axes.
spec.mathematics: Both axes range from -7 to 7; grid step is 1.

spec.description: Completed Cartesian plot of the interval, with endpoints marked and dashed rise/run guides.
